title: Busted
original_lyrics:
[verse]
My bills are all do and the babies need shoes but I'm Busted

[chorus]
I got cow that went dry and hen that won't lay

[bridge]
The county will haul my belongin's away I'm Busted.
I went to my brother to ask for loan I was Busted
I hate to beg like dog for bone but I'm Busted
My brother said there ain't thing I can do
My wife and my kids are all down with the flu
And I was just thinkin' of callin' on you I'm Busted.
Lord I'm no theif but man can go wrong when he's Busted
The food that we canned last summer is gone and I'm Busted
The fields are all bare and the cotton won't grow
Me and my family gotta pack up and go
Where I'll make livin' the Lord only knows but I'm Busted.
?'s [email protected]
